label: File download
when: a document to download, such as a PDF: a menu, a brochure, a price list
rules: Use only a document from "The site's media library" (a "document" line, a PDF): its exact address three times (the comment's "href" and both links) and its ID as "id": {"id":2482,"href":"address"}. The first link is the document's name, the second the download button; keep the example's attributes. The id of the first link is made up, repeated in the button's aria-describedby, and differs in each file block. The button says Download, in the page's language. No preview, no target. If no document fits, write no file block.
example: Spring menuDownload
